home.heroTitle: Move Your Pet From UAE To Europe
home.heroDesc: Expert guidance for UAE expats and rescue sponsors. Document-ready, IATA compliant, and seamlessly managed through our Telegram Concierge.
home.step1Desc: Start a chat with @FlyMyPetBot. Answer a few questions about your pet.
home.step2Desc: Snap photos of vaccination cards and passports directly into the chat.
home.step3Desc: Our human admins review docs, book vet checks, and arrange IATA crates.
home.step4Desc: Get real-time tracking updates until your pet is safely in your arms.
home.matrixDesc: The UAE is considered an "unlisted third country" by the EU. Strict timelines apply. Here is what you need to know.
home.importExportDesc: Relocating a pet from the UAE to Europe involves two sides: exporting from the UAE and importing into your destination country. Here is the full breakdown.
home.notSureDesc: Send us your pet's vaccination records on Telegram and we'll tell you exactly what steps remain and how long it will take.
home.rescueTitle: Help Solve the GCC Pet Crisis
home.rescueDesc: Hundreds of abandoned pets in the UAE have adoptive homes waiting in Europe, but they lack the funds for flights. You can sponsor a "flight buddy" directly.
home.testimonialsTitle: Trusted by Pet Owners Across the UAE
home.testimonialsDesc: Real stories from families who successfully relocated their pets to Europe with our help.
home.faqSubtitle: Everything you need to know about relocating your pet from the UAE to Europe.
home.stillQuestions: Still have questions? We're happy to help.

pricing.title: Simple, Transparent Pricing
pricing.desc: Choose the level of support that works for you. Final pricing depends on destination, pet size, and specific requirements.

footer.description: Safe and reliable pet relocation from the UAE to Europe. We handle documents, vet checks, and flights so your pet travels stress-free.

bot.welcomeTagline: 🐾 Fly My Pet — Pet relocations from the UAE to Europe, guided in this chat.
bot.welcomeFollowUp: We'll walk through your details, your pet, and document uploads — all here. What is your full name?
bot.noRelocations: You don't have any active relocations. Use /start to begin.
bot.volunteer: ✈️ Volunteer as a Flight Companion Thank you for your interest! Please send us the following details: • Your full name • Upcoming flight date • Airline • Route (e.g., Dubai → Lisbon) Send all details in a single message and our team will get back to you.
bot.sponsor: 💝 Sponsor a Rescue Relocation Help an abandoned animal find a home in Europe. Visit our website to see animals needing sponsors, or contact our team here for more information. Every contribution helps save a life! 🐱
bot.stepOwnerPhone: 📱 Share your phone number We need this to contact you about your pet's relocation.
bot.stepOwnerRegionOther: We currently only support relocations from the UAE to Europe. Contact us for other regions.
bot.stepPetType: 🐾 What type of pet are you relocating?
bot.stepPetWeight: ⚖️ What is your pet's weight in kg?
bot.stepTravelOrigin: ✈️ Departure city? Where will your pet fly from?
bot.stepTravelDestination: 🌍 Destination country? Where is your pet going?
bot.stepTravelDateCustom: Type your preferred date (e.g. 2026-05-15 or May 2026):
bot.stepDocuments: 📄 Document Upload Please upload as photos or files: • Vaccination card • Rabies certificate • Pet passport (if available) • Owner ID Tap the button below when finished. 💡 Reply help anytime to speak with a human.
bot.errorUseStart: Please use /start to begin your relocation request.
bot.errorInvalidPhone: Please enter a valid phone number (e.g., +971 50 123 4567)
bot.errorInvalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
bot.helpEscapeHatch: 🚨 We've flagged your request. Our team will reach out to you in this chat as soon as possible (usually within a few hours, often sooner). 📋 Use /status to check your relocation progress.
bot.helpEscapeHatchDirect: 💬 Need immediate assistance? You can also message @{username} directly.
bot.relocationSubmitted: ✅ Your relocation request has been submitted! Use /status to check progress or /start to submit a new request. 💡 Reply help if you need to speak with someone.
bot.uploadDocument: 📎 Please upload a document (photo or file), or tap the button below when finished.
bot.typePhoneNumber: Please type your phone number with country code (e.g. +971 50 123 4567):
bot.documentReceived: ✅ Document received ({docType}) {docCount} document(s) uploaded. Send more or tap Done when finished.
bot.photoReceived: ✅ Photo received ({docType}) {docCount} document(s) uploaded. Send more or tap Done when finished.
bot.notExpectingDocument: I'm not expecting a document right now. Please follow the current step.
bot.notExpectingPhoto: I'm not expecting a photo right now. Please follow the current step.
bot.completeBody: A relocation specialist will reach out to you within 24 hours (usually sooner) — right here in this chat — to review your documents and discuss next steps. 📋 Use /status to check your progress anytime.
bot.completeSupport: 💬 Need immediate assistance? Reply help or message @{username} directly.
bot.completeSupportAlt: 💬 Reply help or urgent anytime to request human support.
bot.notificationDocumentsPending: 📄 We've received your request and are reviewing your documents.
bot.notificationVetVerification: 🏥 Your documents have been approved! We're coordinating vet verification now.
bot.notificationFlightMatching: ✈️ Vet check complete! We're now matching your pet with the best flight.
bot.notificationConfirmed: ✅ Great news! Your pet's flight has been confirmed. We'll send details shortly.
bot.notificationInTransit: 🚀 Your pet is now in transit! We'll update you on arrival.
bot.notificationDelivered: 🏠 Your pet has arrived safely! Thank you for choosing FlyMy.Pet 🐾
bot.notificationCancelled: ❌ Your relocation request has been cancelled. Contact us if you have questions.
